image_description: A close-up shot of a beaded necklace resting on a textured, light purple fabric surface. The necklace features alternating amber-colored spherical beads and white/cream irregular shell or stone pieces, connected by silver wire loops. There are also flat, translucent blue-green circular pendants and small silver spacers. The background fabric has a subtle embossed pattern.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The embossed pattern on the purple fabric appears slightly inconsistent in perspective and sharpness, with some areas looking overly smooth or digitally painted rather than physically textured.

artifact_observations.location: Wire connections near bottom-right blue pendant
artifact_observations.reasoning: The silver wire wrapping around the blue pendant and adjacent beads appears somewhat fused and lacks clear physical definition of how the wire loops secure the beads. It looks slightly 'melted' into the bead surface.
The coiling of the necklace is slightly unnatural; some segments appear to float slightly above the fabric without casting consistent contact shadows, suggesting minor depth grounding issues.

To verify the physical connectivity between beads and wires, ensuring no floating elements or impossible fusions exist.
To assess overall image quality, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture artifacts in both the jewelry and background.
To check for proper contact shadows and depth relationships between the necklace coils and the background fabric.

Contact shadows between necklace and fabric
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the wire-wrapping details. AI often struggles with the complex geometry of wire loops securing beads. Check if the wires logically penetrate or wrap around the beads, or if they appear to merge/fuse. Also, verify if the reflections on the amber beads are consistent with a single light source.
